name: Add a new Gutenberg block
query: Add a new Gutenberg block called 'my-plugin/promo-banner'. The block should have an editor view (index.js) and a frontend view script (view.js).
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run detect_wpboilerplate.mjs to confirm isWPBoilerplate: true and that build artifacts exist
Step 2: Consult references/build-system.md to understand that src/blocks/**/block.json is auto-discovered by webpack
Step 3: Create src/blocks/promo-banner/block.json with name 'my-plugin/promo-banner' and appropriate editorScript/viewScript fields
Step 4: Create src/blocks/promo-banner/index.js (editor script) and src/blocks/promo-banner/view.js (frontend view)
Step 5: Run npm run build — webpack discovers the block automatically via block.json; no manual webpack.config.js edit is needed
Step 6: Confirm build/blocks/promo-banner/index.js and view.js are generated
Step 7: Do NOT manually enqueue block assets in PHP — block.json and wp_register_block_type handle registration
success_criteria: Block files are created under src/blocks/, not directly in build/
block.json is present with the correct block name
webpack.config.js is NOT manually edited for a standard block (auto-discovered)
npm run build is run to compile the block
Block assets are not manually enqueued in PHP Admin\Main or Public\Main
